reasons.testability: The proposed test involves synthesizing a C14-dominant variant and measuring magnetic transitions, which does not test the claimed effect on load-bearing integrity or caloric response in the target alloy, so it cannot falsify the hypothesis as stated.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is off-topic, focusing on magnetic coercivity in a different alloy system, and provides no actionable insight for improving the integrity or caloric performance of the (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 high-entropy alloy.
